name: Background task
summary: The pattern for any long-running process on AhaSlides — import, export, upload, duplicate: a fixed bottom-right card that tracks one background task from start to finish — icon, subject, bar, caption and its terminal states.
highlights: Pattern for any long-running process: import, export, upload, duplicate
File name as the heading, inline link action and the rating
Bar eases towards 90% when there is no real percentage
Stack element: bottom-right, newest on top
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-background-task> — is the presenter's background-task pattern (ImportProgressNotification). It shows a leading task icon, the task's subject (a file, deck or export name), the DS Progress bar in its running state (moving stripes) and a caption row with an optional tertiary Cancel button. It updates in place through five states — progress, success, canceled, offline, error — by toggling attributes on persistent nodes, so the bar animates on the DS motion tokens instead of being recreated. The ✕ appears on success, canceled and error. A `footer` slot carries the inline cancel confirmation or the connection-lost buttons; the success state always shows the DS <aha-csat> rating by default (a finished card without it is not a valid state), and a `footer` overrides it. Cancel is a tertiary <aha-button size="sm">. The consumer owns the task, the copy and the timers (the presenter's Import dismisses a successful card only after the rating is answered or the ✕ is pressed). A process label ("PDF", "Import") can sit before the heading, split from it by a thin divider; the description line can end in an inline link ("Download didn't start? Retry") and the leading icon is centred on heading and description together. A process with no real percentage sets `no-percentage`: the bar eases towards 90% on its own while the caption says what is happening. Several processes share the <aha-background-task-stack> column: one card per process, updated in place, newest on top.
codeNote: Reach for <aha-background-task> for any background process (import, export, upload, duplicate) — a pattern for tracking one task, not a general component. It is not a one-line confirmation (Toast), a titled message (Notification) or a blocking wait (Modal / Spin). Every value binds to a DS token: text-default heading, text-secondary description and caption, radius-lg, the shadow-floating elevation, the space scale, and the type, line-height and motion tokens. The bar is <aha-progress size="small" status="active">, not a hand-made track. Deprecated: <aha-progress-toast> (0.81.0) stays registered as an alias of the same element and the `@ahaslides-product/design/aha-progress-toast` entry still resolves; migrate to <aha-background-task> (the API is unchanged).

spec.label: Dismiss
spec.value: the shared ✕ (tertiary icon-only <aha-button>, size xs; 20 × 20, 16px system-x) on success / canceled / error, top-pinned to the leading icon row, 2px into the end padding

spec.label: Card
spec.value: fixed right --aha-space-24 (24) · bottom --aha-floating-inset-bottom (88) · z-index --aha-layer-floating (1100) · white · 320 wide (max 100vw − 32) · radius-lg (12) · padding 14/16/16 · --aha-shadow-floating (the Notification elevation) · fades in over --aha-motion-slow

spec.label: Heading row
spec.value: heading (the file name with its extension, e.g. Quarterly review.pdf) · check-circle 12 on success; leading icon centred on heading + description when a description shows

spec.label: Top row
spec.value: 24px leading icon (a file task shows its file-type glyph) · heading 14px (--aha-size-default) semibold --aha-text-default, ellipsis · check-circle 12 on success · shared ✕ (tertiary icon-only aha-button xs) on success / canceled / error

spec.label: Bar
spec.value: the DS <aha-progress size="small" status="active">: 6px gray-30 track, primary fill animating on --aha-motion-slow / --aha-ease-out, white stripes moving over the fill (still under prefers-reduced-motion); offline drops the running status and greys the fill to gray-60, still, no stripes; hidden on success / canceled / error

spec.label: Caption row
spec.value: 12px (--aha-size-sm) --aha-text-secondary caption left, 8px below the bar · slot=action right: tertiary small <aha-button>, right edge optically aligned

spec.label: Description
spec.value: 12px (--aha-size-sm) --aha-text-secondary under the heading, 2px gap (canceled / offline / error)

spec.label: Error
spec.value: keeps the same 24px leading task icon as every other state; neutral heading, no border; failure is carried by the heading text and the recovery action in the footer (Try again)

spec.label: Stack
spec.value: <aha-background-task-stack>: same position and layer as the card (right 24 · bottom 88 · --aha-layer-floating) · 320 wide · 8px gap · column; prepend the newest card, one card per process

spec.label: No percentage
spec.value: bar starts at 4% and eases towards 90% (15% of the remaining distance every 700ms), never reaches 100%; the consumer's caption carries the meaning

props.name: state
props.desc: Which of the five states the card shows

props.name: heading
props.desc: The task's subject (file, deck or export name), or a status headline such as "Import cancelled" / "Connection lost" / "Export failed"

props.name: description
props.desc: Line under the heading, e.g. "Download didn't start?" (success), "{n}/{total} slides are now in your deck", "Waiting to reconnect…", "Couldn't create your PDF." (error)

props.name: no-percentage
props.desc: For a process with no real percentage: the bar eases towards 90% on its own and `value` is ignored. Pair with a text caption, never a made-up number

props.name: caption
props.desc: Bottom-left text, e.g. "42%", "Importing slides…", "Almost done…" or "{count}/{total} slides exported"

props.name: rating-prompt
props.desc: Question of the CSAT every finished (success) card shows

props.name: dismiss-label
props.desc: Accessible name of the ✕ — pass the translated string

props.name: slot=icon
props.desc: 24px leading task icon. A file task passes its file-type glyph as <aha-icon slot="icon" name="system-file-…" size="24" decorative>, in the default icon colour with no tint: .pptx/.ppt system-file-ppt (a Google Slides import too), .xlsx/.xls system-file-xls, .pdf system-file-pdf, .csv system-file-csv, .docx/.doc system-file-doc, images system-file-image, anything else system-file. A file task never shows a brand logo here. Other tasks (an export or upload) pass a glyph

props.name: slot=link
props.desc: Inline text action that ends the description, e.g. Retry; flows inline with the description text and wraps with it like a word (never a separate column); styled as the Button link variant (DS link colour, weight 400, underline and hover colour on hover only), with a visible focus ring. An outer style on the link overrides this, so don't recolour it

props.name: slot=footer
props.desc: Cancel confirmation or connection-lost buttons; overrides the default completion rating on success

props.name: dismiss
props.desc: Composed CustomEvent when the ✕ is pressed — the consumer removes the card

whenToUse.when: any long-running process the user keeps working beside — import, export, upload, duplicate
a one-line past-tense confirmation with nothing to track
a titled message with detail and at most one action, not a live task
the user must wait for or answer the task before continuing

opinion.note: One card per task, updated in place. The card has no timers: the consumer dismisses a successful card only after the rating is answered or the ✕ is pressed and leaves canceled / offline / error until the user acts. Cancel with slides already created asks for confirmation in the footer ("Keep waiting" primary, "Cancel import" secondary, small, right-aligned); offline offers "Try again" and "Cancel import". Copy is the consumer's: the presenter's Import uses "Import cancelled", "Connection lost" and "Import failed" and is the reference implementation; an export or upload reuses the same shape with its own verbs. Failed: the leading task icon stays, the heading stays neutral (no red border), one short reason line that names the object ("Couldn’t import your file.") and a primary "Try again" button in the footer that reruns the same process in the same card. Finished: the rating spans the card under a divider, and the card stays until it is rated or dismissed.
opinion.dsv3: Reference implementation mirrors the presenter's ImportProgressNotification.vue and ImportCompletionCSAT.vue (stpancras-presenter-app PR #5833); the presenter's FileTypeIcon.vue still shows brand logos and is a consumer to update. Shadow is the DS Elevate/Overlays effect style (--aha-shadow-floating). The bar is the DS Progress running state. Rating is the DS <aha-csat>. No dedicated Figma component.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI. The [data-probe] is a running card at 42%: a white 320px radius-12 surface, 14px heading in text-default #1A1A1A, and the DS small Progress bar (6px) in its running state.
